content_html: This excerpt is from a book containing outrageous and categorically false allegations. We denied every claim on the record, yet the author provided not a single shred of verifiable evidence to substantiate them. No bank statements, wire transfer records, account numbers, transaction dates, or other verifiable details were provided to support these extraordinary accusations. The above never happened. It is deeply disappointing that Vanity Fair would publish such extraordinary accusations without independently verifying them. This is not journalism. It is fiction being presented as fact.
